copy.action: Button under a message: copies its text to the clipboard.
copy.failed: Tooltip and screen-reader status after copying to the clipboard failed.
scroll-to-end: Round button over the composer: scrolls the conversation to its newest message.
earlier.show: Button at the top of a long conversation: loads older messages.
reactions.group: Screen-reader name of the row of feedback buttons (good reply, bad reply…) under a socio's (AI agent's) reply.
reactions.added: Said to screen readers after a feedback button is pressed. {{reaction}} is the button's name, such as "Good reply".
reactions.removed: Said to screen readers after a feedback button is pressed again. {{reaction}} is the button's name, such as "Good reply".
reactions.counted: Accessible name of a feedback button with how many people pressed it. {{reaction}} is its name ("Try again"), {{total}} the count.
reactions.failed: Short error under a reply when a feedback reaction could not be saved.
reactions.generic-socio: Stands in for a socio's (AI agent's) name when it isn't known; it opens a sentence ("The socio's reply…").
reactions.other-author: Stands in for a person's name when it isn't known; it opens a sentence ("Another person's message…").
reactions.preview-failed: Note under a reply when the app couldn't check what a report (a thumbs-down sent to Ingenio) would include.
over-limit: Note under the message box. {{max}} is the most characters a message may hold, {{count}} how many to remove.
quote.reply: Button under a message: quotes it in the message box to reply to it.
quote.replying-to: Over the message box while replying to a quoted message. {{author}} is the quoted message's author, a person or a socio (AI agent).
quote.remove: Button (an x) that takes the quoted message out of the reply.
quote.command-note: A message starting with / runs a command, except in a reply.
quote.unknown-socio: Stands in for a socio's (AI agent's) name in a quote when it isn't known.
call.ended: A finished voice call in the conversation: {{seconds}} is how long it lasted, in seconds (s).
not-sent.announce: Said to screen readers when a message fails to send. {{excerpt}} is the message's first words.
not-sent.retry-named: Accessible name of the Retry button under a message that wasn't sent. {{excerpt}} is the message's first words.
not-sent.retry-later: Tooltip of a disabled Retry button: the socio (AI agent) is still writing a reply.
not-sent.edit-named: Accessible name of the Edit button under a message that wasn't sent. {{excerpt}} is the message's first words.
viewer.position: In the attachment viewer: which file of how many is shown, such as "2 of 5".
viewer.next: Button in the attachment viewer: shows the next file.
attachment.list: Screen-reader name of the list of files attached to a message.
attachment.image: Name of an attached image that has no file name.
attachment.unnamed: Name of an attached file that has no file name.
attachment.removed: Beside an attachment whose file was deleted.
status.paused: Under the socio's (AI agent's) name in the chat header: an admin paused Socio (the product).
status.updating: Under the socio's name in the chat header: the server is restarting for an update.
status.here: Under the socio's (AI agent's) name in the chat header: the chat is connected and ready.
header.model-tip: Tooltip of the chat header's AI model picker.
header.model: Accessible name of the chat header's AI model picker.
header.save-page: Button in the chat header: saves the conversation as a page in a Space (a shared area of pages).
header.save-page-later: Tooltip of the disabled save-as-page button while the socio (AI agent) is still replying.
header.page-title: Prompt (a browser dialog) asking for the new page's title.
header.schedule: Button in the chat header: schedules a repeating task in this conversation.
header.voice-needs-self-hosted: Tooltip of the disabled voice-call button. "Settings → General → Transcription" names screens in the app; keep it in line with their names.
header.voice-needs-cloud: Tooltip of the disabled voice-call button for admins. VOICE_API_KEY and VOICE_MODEL are setting names: don't translate them.
header.voice-start-tip: Tooltip of the chat header's call button. A socio is an AI agent.
page-context: Banner over a chat about a page. <pageLink> wraps {{title}}, the page's title, as a link: keep the tags.
welcome.title: Heading of an empty conversation. Warm, short.
welcome.text: Line under an empty conversation's heading. A socio is an AI agent.
notice.updating-running: Socio (the product) is restarting for an update while a message waits to be sent.
error.reconnect: Button on a chat's error: connects the chat again.
error.cloud-voice: Button on a failed self-hosted voice call: retries with the cloud voice service.
voice-note: Small line under the message box: typing and voice calls share one conversation.
queued.list: Screen-reader name of the messages waiting for the socio (AI agent) to read them.
queued.others: Screen-reader name of other people's waiting messages in a room, as an admin sees them.
queued.note: Under a waiting message. {{note}} says when the socio (AI agent) reads it, such as "Ada reads this on its next turn".
queued.held: Under someone's waiting message in a room. {{name}} is that person, who can't write in the room now.
queued.keep: Button: stops editing a waiting message, keeping it as it was.
queued.cancel-ask: Asks an admin to confirm canceling another person's waiting message. {{name}} is that person.
queued.keep-it: Button: answers no to canceling another person's waiting message.
queued.file-count: How many files a waiting message carries.
